Folks — I reviewed BrightScale's redline and Emily's summary. Uploaded my proposed edits into the attached doc and added a 2-sheet summary (redline-comments-summary.xlsx) with rationale for each requested change. Key calls: 

1) Roles & routing: Accept the role map as proposed, but add a short exhibit that enumerates which deployment modes allow customer key control and which use Redwood-managed keys (exhibit A). This keeps the DPA short while preserving operational specifics in the exhibit.

2) SCCs / transfer addendum: Redwood is on the 2021 SCC modules. We can sign the standard EU SCCs and a one-page transfer addendum that lists the permitted hosting scenarios (hosted, dedicated, private) and corresponding transfer controls. That addendum will include commitments around encryption-in-transit, logging, and subprocessor notification windows.

3) Liability/order form: Will not accept a change that effectively expands indemnity. Offer: refine the SLO credit language and add a cap carveout only for gross negligence/intent. Suggest specific wording in the attached order form PDF.

Timeline: I can finalize the consolidated redline by EOD 11/21 if Emily confirms the 11:00 PT sync — otherwise EOD 11/22. Priya/Ben — please confirm whether you want me to join the sync.
